EN简繁

Everything can be a plugin.
Find them here.

DeepSeek Harness is built around plugins, yet it ships no list or recommendations for community ones. The October 15 update added an official plugin market: paste one index JSON and you can browse and install community plugins without downloading anything by hand. So we built this index.

→
ToolsSkillsMemory

Quick start

  1. 1Turn on the market

  2. 2Add a source

  3. 3Paste the URL

How it looks in DSH

Stars aren't everything here. The default picks refresh every day and put fast-growing, actively shipped, genuinely good plugins first, with verification, downloads and stars as supporting signals.

  • No single author can flood the list, so a newcomer can make the first screen
  • Rising, Frequent updates and Verified labels at a glance
  • Default order, ✨ Smart picks and Random: every visit turns up something new
